title: frameledger check --json
description: The result of `frameledger check FILE... --json`: whether each file meets the run-file format. A later release may add keys, and values to the open sets; a script ignores what it does not know. Print this file from the same frameledger that printed the result.

frameledger.description: The version of the frameledger that printed this.

summary.description: The opening sentences of the text output, in order. Wording may change in any release.

overrides.description: The --override flags given; empty for a command that takes none.

warnings.description: The warnings, each also a sentence in summary.

line.description: The line of the file, from 1.

rule.description: Which part of the format is broken. An open set.

breaches.description: Each place the file breaks the format; empty when it conforms.

files.description: Each file that was read. A file that could not be read is left out, and has a file_error warning.

matches.description: True when FILE meets the format and holds what the expected file holds.

where.description: Where in the run the two differ.

expected.description: What the expected file holds there. Any JSON value.

found.description: What FILE holds there. Any JSON value.

expect.description: Written only with --expect, and only when the file could be read: how FILE compares with the expected run file, by content.

result.description: What was found in each file.

check_verdict.description: The verdict of check: pass when every file conforms, fail when one breaks the format, has a warning under --strict or differs under --expect, error when a file could not be read. A closed set.

check_exit_code.description: The exit codes a check result can carry. A closed set.

code.description: What kind of warning it is. An open set: a later release may add a code, and a script ignores one it does not know. file_error says a file could not be read.

warning.description: One warning. Its sentence is also in summary.

field.description: The header field that may differ.

override.description: One blocking field a --override flag let differ.
